digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. V, App. VI

teaser.en: A fern that keeps the water in the bucket: its fronds float on top to stop it splashing on the carrier's head.
teaser.sw: Kivumbasi kinachotuliza maji ndooni: majani yake huelea juu ili maji yasimrukie mbebaji kichwani.
teaser.dg: *Fern* inayorinda madzi ndooni: makodzage nkuikpwa dzulu ya madzi ili gasimwagike dzulu ya chitswa cha mutu anayedzihika ndoo.

summary.en: Mvwiko is Davallia chaerophylloides, a lacy fern. Its fronds are laid on the water in a bucket carried on the head, as floaters that stop it spilling.
summary.sw: Mvwiko ni Davallia chaerophylloides, kivumbasi chenye majani maridadi kama lesi. Majani yake hutandazwa juu ya maji ndani ya ndoo inayobebwa kichwani, yakielea ili maji yasimwagike.
summary.dg: *Mvwiko* ni *Davallia chaerophylloides*, *fern* yenye makodza ganagoganyika sana kukala vipande vidide. Makodzage nkuikpwa dzulu ya madzi ga ndoo inayodzihikwa chitswani, dza *mivwiko* inayoelea, ili madzi gasimwagike.

about.en: Mvwiko is a fern with a thick, creeping rhizome covered in brown scales, from which finely divided, lacy, triangular fronds arise. The tiny spore cases sit in small cups near the edges of the leaflets. The Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: Mvwiko ni kivumbasi chenye kiazi (shina la chini ya ardhi) kinene kinachotambaa na kufunikwa na magamba ya kahawia, ambacho huchipuza majani yaliyogawanyika kwa unyoofu, maridadi kama lesi, yenye umbo la pembetatu. Vifuko vidogo sana vya vijimbegu (spora) hukaa ndani ya vikombe vidogo karibu na kingo za vijani. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Mvwiko* ni *fern* yenye seemu kulu inayoambala (*rhizome*), iriyofwinikpwa ni vipande vidide vya rangi ya dongo, na kula phapho kunatuluka makodza (*fronds*) ganagoganyika sana kukala vipande vidide, ga umbo ra pembe tahu. Mbeyu ndide sana (*spores*) zinakala kpwenye vikombe vidide phephi na kanda za makodza madide. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows on tree trunks, rocks and shaded banks in moist forest and thicket.
where.sw: Huota juu ya vigogo vya miti, miambani na kwenye kingo zenye kivuli katika misitu na vichaka vyenye unyevunyevu.
where.dg: Unamera dzulu ya makolo ga mihi, mawe na kanda-kanda zenye chivuri-vuri, kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vyenye chinemi.

uses.en: Pakia records that the leaves are put into a bucket of water as floaters (mivwiko) to keep the water from spilling onto the person carrying it on her head.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba majani yake huwekwa ndani ya ndoo ya maji kama vielea (mivwiko) ili maji yasimwagikie mtu anayeibeba kichwani.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala makodza nkutiywa ndooni ya madzi dza *mivwiko* (vitu vinavyoelea) ili madzi gasimwagike dzulu ya mutu anayeidzihika chitswani.

culture.en: Pakia lists Mvwiko among names that describe a plant's product, alongside Msabuni (soap) and Msuwaki (toothbrush).
culture.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha Mvwiko miongoni mwa majina yanayoeleza kitu kinachotokana na mmea, pamoja na Msabuni (sabuni) na Msuwaki (mswaki).
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika *Mvwiko* kahi ya madzina ganagoeleza chitu chinacholavywa ni mmea, phamwenga na *Msabuni* (sabuni) na *Msuwaki* (msuwaki).

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mvwiko, meaning 'floaters', after the mivwiko placed in water buckets. The same name is used for bracken, Pteridium aquilinum. Pakia's English name is simply 'fern'; its scientific name is Davallia chaerophylloides.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mvwiko, lenye maana ya 'vielea', kutokana na mivwiko inayowekwa kwenye ndoo za maji. Jina hilohilo hutumika kwa *bracken*, Pteridium aquilinum. Jina la Kiingereza analotoa Pakia ni *fern* tu; jina lake la kisayansi ni Davallia chaerophylloides.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mvwiko*, ririro na mana ya 'vitu vinavyoelea', kula kpwa *mivwiko* inayoikpwa ndooni. Dzina hiri hiri nkuhumirwa piya kpwa *bracken*, *Pteridium aquilinum*. Dzina ra Chingereza ra Pakia ni *fern* tu; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Davallia chaerophylloides*.

reason.en: Also named after a household product
reason.sw: Nao umepewa jina la kitu cha matumizi ya nyumbani
reason.dg: Piya una dzina ra chitu cha kuhumira nyumbani

reason.en: Another plant that grows on trees
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaoota juu ya miti
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaomera dzulu ya mihi
